purpose: Fresh-container capacity and regression checks, not replacement headline benchmarks

runtime.deployment: Public Dockerfile built from an empty Docker image cache; public docker_serve.sh; read-only checkpoint mount; no native runtime mounts
runtime.checkpoint_check: Target/MTP indices, shard headers, tensor counts and payload byte totals passed; tensor payload hashes were not repeated in this run
runtime.cuda_peer_access: Both directions passed capability checks and tensor-copy equality checks inside the image
runtime.qsa: approximate, with the 64 MiB workspace fix
runtime.max_parallel_loading_workers: 1 passed by launcher; ignored by pinned runtime
runtime.swap: 8 GiB original plus 56 GiB temporary loading swap; temporary file removed after each server

two_clients.request_recipe: repo-chat; second client rotates the public source corpus by half its characters; unique cache salt per request; greedy forced-length outputs
two_clients.warmup_policy: One short pair followed by one full-context pair; no repeated statistical runs
two_clients.cleanup: Server stopped normally; temporary swap removed; original swap retained

single_request_hot84.settings_note: Image defaults, with no hot-cache or capacity overrides
single_request_hot84.request_recipe: repo-chat, unique cache salt per request, greedy forced-length outputs
single_request_hot84.cleanup: Server stopped normally; temporary swap removed; original swap retained
single_request_hot84.limits: Fresh server, not cold filesystem. First-use JIT warnings occurred during inference. No explicit warmup or repeats; short outputs are capacity evidence, not sustained-decode benchmarks.

limits: One server launch per profile and one run per shape on one host; no universal driver or display-memory guarantee.
Decode overlap is the intersection of both streams' generation intervals; do not sum rates whose intervals differ.
The first long client's generation overlaps the second client's prefill. Its whole-generation rate is not isolated decode throughput.
Forced output lengths and small isolation checks do not constitute a model-quality evaluation.
Fresh container startup includes kernel compilation. The existing checkpoint and host filesystem cache were reused.
Host swap was used and sample vmstat checks observed page-ins; these are not fully RAM-resident performance claims.
